integrity: The finite certificate reconstructs the extended binary Golay code and all standard minimal Leech vectors, filters exactly the source conic constraints, and exhausts every pair. The projective-orbit sizes are kept as a separate published premise and are not fabricated by the checker.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the 800-conic Mukai quartic and the published Leech-lattice realization. The geometric realization of all 800 lattice classes is a cited premise. The 2024 companion PDF and the directly relevant Leech GAP file were inspected, but the remaining ancillary corpus was not exhaustive, so a machine-readable equivalent remains a literature-overlap risk.
title: Intersection profiles of the 800 conics on the Mukai quartic
